title: Plain 1U blanks
summary: Plain blank panels in the repository’s 1U format. The HP names identify nominal width variants; consult each native board for the actual outline and mounting holes.

title: Plain 3U blanks
summary: Plain blank panels in the repository’s 3U format. Width variants share a family identity, but each native project retains its own outline and holes. The 8HP project also includes STL and editable FreeCAD files in 3D & Files.

title: 3U to 1U adapter
summary: A mechanical adapter project connecting the 3U and 1U formats. Its native board is the editable panel source; the STEP file provides a separate mechanical model for fit inspection.

title: Side frames and pads
summary: Side frames have 1U, 3U and 7U variants. Matching pad projects are retained for 1U and 3U. Frames and pads are separate native parts; consult their outlines before combining them.

title: Saucer 1: Slow Wave
